prerequisites: All examinations of the first study section passed
At least 20 ECTS from modules of the first two semesters of the second study section achieved

learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply scientific methods from their studies to concrete problems in computer science.
Students are aware of future professional requirements.
Students know the fundamental elements of everyday business life.
Students can independently solve tasks or sub-tasks aligned with their study progress.
Students can contribute to the overall success as a member of a project team.
Deepen practical activities in the professional profile of a computer scientist, including designing IT systems.
Deepen practical activities in the professional profile of a computer scientist, including implementing IT systems.
Deepen practical activities in the professional profile of a computer scientist, including acquiring, integrating, and supporting IT systems.
Deepen practical activities in the professional profile of a computer scientist, including testing IT systems.

syllabus_topics: Selection of a suitable company in Germany or abroad
Collaboration on concrete operational tasks using learned scientific methods
Active participation in team meetings with contributions to work progress
Exploration of development tools used in the company (IDE, RCS, Ticket system, CI/CD)
Creation of a work plan for the internship with defined work packages to be processed independently
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on the submission of an internship report (PrB). Further details can be found in the Appendix SPO.
